thread:
alex: incident-bot paged me at 07:21 UTC — 504s on inference-router-prod, error spike. paging to oncall.

sre-bot: [INCIDENT] High 5xx rate on /v1/generate (router) — triggered at 07:21:03 UTC. Severity: P1. Oncall: @lee-oncall. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/INC-2026-042

lee-oncall: I'm on it, joining bridge now. @jordan can you check recent deploys? :eyes:

jordan: no prod deploys in last 6 hours. Checking autoscaler logs and pods.

maria: I see node GPU memory pressure on cluster-3, OOM events around 07:19. Could be batch queue backlog.

lee-oncall: throttling routing to fallback-model-v2 for low-tier customers to reduce load. Implemented at 07:26 — reducing p50 latency but still seeing errors.

jordan: logs show connection resets from model-worker-7, repeated `rpc: connection reset by peer` starting 07:18.

alex: rolling a quick restart on worker pool 7, doing a warmup sequence afterwards. ETA 10m.

opsmgr: notified principals, starting customer impact assessment. @anna-cs please prepare status page draft.

anna-cs: drafting now. Initial note: "Partial degraded service for text generation endpoints; engineering investigation underway. No data exfiltration. More updates in 30m." Will paste draft for sign-off.

statuspage-bot: Status page incident created: redwood.status/incident-215000-1

lee-oncall: restart completed on worker pool 7 at 07:36. Error rate dropped to baseline at 07:38. Monitoring for 30m.

jordan: confirmed KV cache invalidation during restart caused elevated latency for some requests, we have a race in cache warmup + connection churn.

maria: root cause hypothesis: model-worker OOM triggered connection closing which caused router retries and cache churn; complex interplay with recent config that increased batch size for throughput.

alex: good notes. Let's not finalize RCA on the bridge. We'll schedule postmortem and collect logs/traces. @opsmgr please own postmortem scheduling.

opsmgr: will schedule. Proposed slot: tomorrow 16:00 UTC (60m). Invite: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-oncall, product, cs. I'll create the doc and timeline.

anna-cs: status page update approved. Posting now. message: "We've mitigated an incident affecting text generation; service restored. We'll follow up with an RCA within 48 hours." :white_check_mark:

statuspage-bot: Status update posted at 07:45 UTC.

lee-oncall: action items from bridge:
- A1: investigate OOM root cause and add guardrails (owner: maria, due: 3d)
- A2: add retry backoff and smoother cache warmup to reduce churn at restart (owner: jordan, due: 1w)
- A3: temporary traffic shaping rule to prevent large batch bursts (owner: alex, due: today)
- A4: customer comms draft and executive summary (owner: anna-cs, due: 48h)

maria: I'm starting A1. Preliminary theory: GPU memory leak in model v2 under specific long-context workloads. Collecting metrics.

jordan: A2 I'll prototype a staggered warmup and bump logs. I'll add a canary for cache warming.

alex: A3 implemented a short rule at 08:05 to cap batch size for 2h. Monitoring looks good.

anna-cs: A4 I'll prepare the RCA summary for customers once the technical draft is ready. Need a one-paragraph explanation and a timeline.

opsmgr: created PM doc: https://drive.redwood/postmortems/INC-215000. Invites sent. Please add evidence: traces, heap dumps, config diffs.

maria: uploaded heap snapshots and GPU logs to the doc.

jordan: uploaded router traces and restart logs.

lee-oncall: small follow-up: add a fallback policy that prefers model-variants with lower memory footprints when cluster memory pressure detected. Filed RFC: https://go.redwood/fallback-policy.

anna-cs: customer comms plan:
- T+0: initial status page (done)
- T+8h: internal technical summary + customer-facing RCA draft for partners
- T+48h: final RCA and remediation timeline
- Offer: 1:1 customer briefings on request

alex: approved. Also plan exec brief for tomorrow.

opsmgr: postmortem scheduled 16:00 UTC. Please ensure owners set due dates in the doc and add acceptance criteria for action items.

statuspage-bot: Reminder: incident will be marked resolved after 72h of stable metrics.

anna-cs: tagging top impacted customers list and drafting outreach templates. Will share in #customer-impact tomorrow.

lee-oncall: closing bridge. If regressions occur ping me directly. Thanks everyone for fast response. :pray:

alex: thanks team. We'll track A1-A4 in the postmortem doc and update customer comms accordingly.

sre-bot: Incident INC-215000 closed on bridge at 08:20 UTC; transitioned to postmortem tracking.

anna-cs: action: schedule exec sync for RCA sign-off — tentative 18:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll send calendar invite.

opsmgr: noted. I'll add to the postmortem timeline. End of thread.
